archetype.name: Elemental Sprite
archetype.description: Sprites are lesser elementals which are embodiments of their raw element, but lack the sapience of their greater kin.

taxonomy.name: Skeleton
taxonomy.description: Undeathly denizens fashioned of bone and sinew.

gesturefan000000.name: Gesture: Fan
gesturefan000000.description:
You shape the essence of a Rune into a sweeping or splintered arc to strike multiple targets in close proximity.

The Fan gesture scales using Intellect and targets a 120 degree arc with a 6 foot radius. It deals 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

falseAppearance0.name: False Appearance
falseAppearance0.description: While it remains motionless, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} is indistinguishable from some other object or material.

runeDeath0000000.name: Rune: Death
runeDeath0000000.description:
The orderly force of destruction, responsible for the corruption of all biological matter. The Death rune governs decay and destruction.

The Death rune scales using Presence, targets Fortitude, and deals Corruption damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Life.

ennervate.name: Ennervate
ennervate.description:
Your command of the Rune of Death allows for basic communion with the dead and for rudimentary manipulation of unholy forces, producing one of the following effects:

  • Spread decay over an object no larger than a 1-foot cube, causing plants to wither, metallic objects to rust, wood to become rotten, food to grow foul, or a corpse to rapidly decompose. Magical objects are typically unaffected.

  • Cause a corpse which has been dead for less than seven days or otherwise preserved to perform a lifeless reenactment of its final moments. Its movements imitate those that occurred during the creature's final 30 seconds of life. You have no control over the creature nor can it communicate in any other way.

  • Hasten the death of a willing creature that is currently dying, causing it to pass swiftly and peacefully.

Ennervate may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

archetype.name: Elemental Visitor
archetype.description: Visitors are embodiments of raw elemental energy that assume forms that are vaguely humanoid in shape. Unlike their lesser kin, Elemental Visitors are are capable of communication and understanding, although their motivations are seldom aligned with those of mortals.

taxonomy.name: Fire Elemental
taxonomy.description: Elemental creatures corresponding to the element of Fire.

fireAbsorption00.name: Fire Absorption
fireAbsorption00.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has an exceptional ability to thrive within scorching environments. Its Fire resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

gesturefan000000.name: Gesture: Fan
gesturefan000000.description:
You shape the essence of a Rune into a sweeping or splintered arc to strike multiple targets in close proximity.

The Fan gesture scales using Intellect and targets a 120 degree arc with a 6 foot radius. It deals 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

gestureaspect000.name: Gesture: Aspect
gestureaspect000.description:
You infuse the essence of a Rune into your body, empowering your own physical form or psyche.

When you assume a certain Aspect, you become more closely attuned to the damage type of the Rune used in your spell. You gain +2 Resistance to that damage type, and deal an additional +2 Damage whenever dealing damage of that type.

Your Aspect lasts for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Aspect; casting another spell using the Aspect gesture replaces the previous effect. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 2 Action and 1 Focus.

runeFlame0000000.name: Rune: Flame
runeFlame0000000.description:
The chaotic force of elemental, thermal energy. The Flame rune governs fire and heat.

The Flame rune scales using Intellect, targets Reflex, and deals Fire damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Frost.

enkindle.name: Enkindle
enkindle.description:
Your command of the Rune of Flame allows you to manipulate fire and thermal energy in creative ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Manifest a burst of elemental flame in one inch sphere which can ignite a candle, torch, or other flammable materials.

  • Imbue your body with momentary thermal shielding which provides you with immunity to fire damage on an immediately subsequent action that costs 1 Action or less.

  • Control the movement of flames within a small area, causing them to flicker, dance, or shift in an animated performance of light and shadow.

Enkindle may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

biography.public: The Ancestral Guardian is less a creature than a presence: the gathered spirits of those who came before, called into the world by a @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.warden0000000000]{Warden} through the Ancestral Grove. It cannot be commanded or reasoned with and offers no speech. It simply keeps watch over the living for as long as the Warden's communion endures.
biography.appearance: A translucent figure woven of shifting bark, leaf, and root, lit from within by a soft green glow. It holds no fixed form, drifting between the silhouettes of ancestors half-remembered, and casts neither shadow nor weight upon the ground it guards.

archetype.name: Ancestral Ward
archetype.description: A watchful spirit that anchors a protective grove.

taxonomy.name: Ancestral Spirit
taxonomy.description: An incorporeal manifestation of ancestral spirits, summoned to watch over the living. It has no corporeal body to wound and no will to break.

ancestralForm000.name: Ancestral Manifestation
ancestralForm000.description: The Ancestral Guardian is an incorporeal manifestation of watchful spirits. It cannot be harmed, moved against its will, or broken, and other creatures may pass freely through its space. Its overwhelming presence on the battlefield causes it to count as three creatures when determining whether an enemy is Flanked.

archetype.name: Elemental Visitor
archetype.description: Visitors are embodiments of raw elemental energy that assume forms that are vaguely humanoid in shape. Unlike their lesser kin, Elemental Visitors are are capable of communication and understanding, although their motivations are seldom aligned with those of mortals.

taxonomy.name: Storm Elemental
taxonomy.description: Elemental creatures corresponding to the element of Storm.

runeStorm0000000.name: Rune: Storm
runeStorm0000000.description:
The chaotic force of raw electrical energy. The Storm rune governs sources of electrical charge and discharge.

The Storm rune scales using Intellect, targets Reflex, and deals Electricity damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Earth.

energize.name: Energize
energize.description:
Your command of the Rune of Storm allows you to conduct the flow of both air and electricity, manipulating charge and aerodynamics to produce one of the following effects:

  • Instill an electromagnetic charge into a metallic object that you touch no larger than a one-foot cube, causing it to strongly adhere to other metals. Only one object can be charged in this way at a given time, casting this spell on a different object causes the prior object to lose its magnetic effect.

  • Gather a squall of wind at your current location in a six-foot radius which blows either as a gust in a single controlled direction or as a cyclone with centripetal force in all directions. Airborne effects in the immediate area are dispersed and unsecured objects with weight less than 1 are flung in the direction of the gust.

  • Produce the concussive sound of a thunderclap at a location you can see within 15 feet of your current position.

Energize may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

electricityAbsor.name: Electricity Absorption
electricityAbsor.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has an exceptional ability to take lightning blasts in stride. Its Electricity resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

archetype.name: Bestial Companion
archetype.description: Beasts which, through magical means or training, have developed into loyal companions.

taxonomy.name: Beast of the Air
taxonomy.description: Companion beasts who take to the skies. Their view from above can provide their masters a strong tactical advantage, and they remain dexterous enough to aid in combat when necessary.

glider0000000000.name: Glider
glider0000000000.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} controls its descent while falling. Unless it is @Condition[incapacitated] or @Condition[restrained], a fall becomes a Glide: a downward Fly movement instead of an impact, suffering no falling damage.

While gliding the creature's @Rule[movement.stride] is doubled and it is granted a @Rule[movement.freeMovement]{free move}, so it can always glide at least a short distance. Its glide must descend, and wherever the movement ends is where it comes to rest; if it ends the glide still aloft it gains the @Condition[flying] condition.

fallGlide.name: Glide
fallGlide.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} glides rather than falls, flying downward under control. The movement must descend and suffers no falling damage. If the creature ends its glide while still aloft it gains the @Condition[flying] condition.

rake000000000000.name: Rake
rake000000000000.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} attacks rapidly with its talons, dealing multiple raking blows against a single target.

rake.name: Rake
rake.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} attacks swiftly with claws or talons.

If at least one attack results in a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess], it inflicts the @Condition[bleeding] condition for 2 Rounds.

echolocation0000.name: Echolocation
echolocation0000.description:
@ref[actor.name]{This creature} perceives the world through the emission of sonic pulses that detect shapes with precision, allowing it to locate creatures that are moving or otherwise emitting sound, up to 60 feet away as long as they are not behind total cover. If the creature is @Condition[deafened], this sense may not be used.

A creature detected using @ref[name] is treated as visible for the purposes of actions which require you to see your target.

description.public: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has curved talons for gripping and rending prey.

battleWorn000000.name: Battle-Worn
battleWorn000000.description: Your body has endured so many injuries that it has learned how to mend itself with remarkable efficiency. When you perform the @Action[default rest] action, you recover additional @Rule[resource.wounds] equal to half your @Rule[ability.toughness] score (rounded down).

loyalProtector00.name: Loyal Protector
loyalProtector00.description: @ref[actor.name]{The companion} is fiercely loyal to its master, and will move to their side and provide defensive assistance immediately upon request.

loyalProtector.name: Loyal Protector
loyalProtector.description: @ref[actor.name]{The companion} moves adjacent to its master, providing them with the @Condition[guarded] condition until the start of their next turn.

flankingManeuver.name: Flanking Maneuver
flankingManeuver.description: Working in tandem with its master, @ref[actor.name]{the companion} can create openings in the defenses of even the most attentive opponents.

flankingManeuver.name: Flanking Maneuver
flankingManeuver.description: @ref[actor.name]{The companion} makes a deliberate strike at an opponent who is currently being engaged by its master. On a hit, the opponent becomes @Condition[overrun] until the start of its next turn.

archetype.name: Bestial Companion
archetype.description: Beasts which, through magical means or training, have developed into loyal companions.

taxonomy.name: Beast of the Land
taxonomy.description: Companion beasts who stride across land. Their strength and pack hunter tactics serve their masters well, often acting as another frontline team member.

pouncingStrike00.name: Pouncing Strike
pouncingStrike00.description: This creature lunges forward, putting its whole weight behind a leaping strike.

pouncingStrike.name: Pouncing Strike
pouncingStrike.description:
This attack may be used after a Move that brings the @ref[actor.name]{creature} at least 10 feet closer to its target. If the creature was above the target, this attack gains @Rule[dice.boon]{+1 Boon} per 10 feet of elevation decrease in that movement.

If this attack is a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit}, the target of the attack is immediately knocked @Condition[prone].

packhunter000000.name: Pack Hunter
packhunter000000.description:
This creature is a pack hunter, relying on its allies to flank and harrass a target to render it exposed to further harm.

This creature doubles number of @Rule[dice.boon]{Boons} awarded from attacking a @Condition[flanked] enemy.

darkvision000000.name: Darkvision
darkvision000000.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can see in darkness as though it were dim light up to 60 feet away, perceiving its surroundings in shades of grey. Darkvision does not function while the @ref[actor.name]{creature} is @Condition[blinded].

description.public: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has a thick, leathery hide that is resilient against attack.
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} possesses a formidable bite of sharp teeth.

archetype.name: Bestial Companion
archetype.description: Beasts which, through magical means or training, have developed into loyal companions.

taxonomy.name: Beast of the Sea
taxonomy.description: Companion beasts who dwell in the deep. Their blindsight can reveal to their masters the location of would-be hidden enemies, and woe unto any who find themselves ensnared by such beasts.

ensnare000000000.name: Ensnare
ensnare000000000.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} lashes out with a grasping tendril, coil, or limb to seize prey at range and drag it into a crushing hold.

ensnare.name: Ensnare
ensnare.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} reaches out to seize a single target within range, attacking its @Rule[defense.reflex]. On a success the target is dragged back into reach and becomes @Condition[restrained]. This action may only be used on creatures which are eligible targets for @Action[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.grapple000000000 grapple].

The hold is maintained until the @ref[actor.name]{creature} releases it, the target escapes, or a different creature is targeted with Ensnare.

blindsight000000.name: Blindsight
blindsight000000.description: @ref[actor.name]{This creature} perceives its surroundings without the use of sight, sensing the precise location of creatures and objects within 60 feet. It is unaffected by @Condition[blinded], darkness, or invisibility, and any creature it detects this way is treated as visible to it.

slipperyForm0000.name: Slippery Form
slipperyForm0000.description: This creature is permanently slippery, giving it the ability to elude capture by physical restraints.

slipperyEscape.name: Slippery Escape
slipperyEscape.description: The creature uses it slippery form to escape restraints, immediately ending the @Condition[restrained] condition.

taxonomy.description: Elemental creatures corresponding to the element of Frost.

gestureinfluence.name: Gesture: Influence
gestureinfluence.description:
You intensify the arcane power of a Rune into a concentrated direct contact which is generally a more powerful evolution of the basic Touch gesture.

The Influence gesture scales using Presence and targets a single adjacent creature. It deals 10 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

coldAbsorption00.name: Cold Absorption
coldAbsorption00.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has an exceptional ability to thrive within frigid environments. Its Cold resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

amorphous0000000.name: Amorphous
amorphous0000000.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} may move through a space as narrow as 1 inch in diameter without any penalty to its Stride. It gains a bonus to Dodge equal to half its Toughness score and is immune to the @Condition[restrained] condition.

aqueousTransmiss.name: Aqueous Transmission
aqueousTransmiss.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} is able to move instantaneously through water.

aqueousTransmission.name: Aqueous Transmission
aqueousTransmission.description: When the @ref[actor.name]{creature} is within water, it can instantaneously transport itself to any unoccupied space within the same body of water up to 120 feet away. It does not need to be able to see the destination to make this Move.

runeFrost0000000.name: Rune: Frost
runeFrost0000000.description:
The orderly force of water and cold. The Frost rune governs the creation of water or other fluids and their transfer between liquid and frozen states.

The Frost rune scales using Wisdom, targets Fortitude, and deals Cold damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Flame.

condense.name: Condense
condense.description:
Your command of the Rune of Frost allows you to manipulate liquids and their thermal properties, producing one of the following effects:

  • Draw up to one quarter gallon of fresh water from the atmosphere into a container or upon a surface you touch. The created water may be affected by relevant atmospheric properties of your current location.

  • Manipulate the temperature of up to 1 gallon of water, causing it to immediately freeze or thaw. The water need not be in a container; this technique can be used to coat a surface or join two objects together via regelation. Ice created in this way remains frozen for as long as the ambient temperature of the environment allows.

  • Gather up to a six-foot cube of nearby snow, forming it into a solidified sculpture, shape, or shelter.

Condense may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

gesturefan000000.name: Gesture: Fan
gesturefan000000.description:
You shape the essence of a Rune into a sweeping or splintered arc to strike multiple targets in close proximity.

The Fan gesture scales using Intellect and targets a 120 degree arc with a 6 foot radius. It deals 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

gestureaspect000.name: Gesture: Aspect
gestureaspect000.description:
You infuse the essence of a Rune into your body, empowering your own physical form or psyche.

When you assume a certain Aspect, you become more closely attuned to the damage type of the Rune used in your spell. You gain +2 Resistance to that damage type, and deal an additional +2 Damage whenever dealing damage of that type.

Your Aspect lasts for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Aspect; casting another spell using the Aspect gesture replaces the previous effect. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 2 Action and 1 Focus.

runeEarth0000000.name: Rune: Earth
runeEarth0000000.description:
The orderly force of elemental earth, responsible for physical matter. The Earth rune governs minerals, metals, soils, and other physical compounds.

The Earth rune scales using Wisdom, targets Reflex, and deals Acid damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Storm.

mould.name: Mould
mould.description:
Your command of the Rune of Earth allows you to manipulate raw forces of rock, mineral, and soil in basic ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Quickly shape up to one cubic foot of available material into a simple geometric form like a cuboid, ellipsoid, or polyhedron.

  • Precisely copy the physical shape of a held object that is smaller than a 6-inch cube, reproducing it from available clay, stone, or metal. The replica retains no useful properties except for its physical form.

  • Separate and collect earthen particles from the surface of an object, creature, or liquid that you touch, rendering the subject completely cleaned or purified in moments.

Mould may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

description.public: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} strikes with a dripping limb of corrosive ichor.

archetype.name: Elemental Sprite
archetype.description: Sprites are lesser elementals which are embodiments of their raw element, but lack the sapience of their greater kin.

taxonomy.name: Earth Elemental
taxonomy.description: Elemental creatures corresponding to the element of Earth.

gestureray000000.name: Gesture: Ray
gestureray000000.description:
You funnel the arcane power of a Rune into a point and project it outwards in a beam.

The Ray gesture scales using Wisdom and produces a line that is 1 foot wide and 30 feet long originating from the spellcaster, dealing 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. The gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.

acidAbsorption00.name: Acid Absorption
acidAbsorption00.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has an exceptional ability to thrive within acidic environments. Its Acid resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

falseAppearance0.name: False Appearance
falseAppearance0.description: While it remains motionless, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} is indistinguishable from some other object or material.
